name: Chapter Rail
summary: Right-edge scroll rail: one dot per section, the current dot morphs into a pill that fills as the section scrolls by.
useWhen: A long landing page needs a quiet where-am-I indicator with jump links
You want a scroll progress cue that does not take a header or sidebar
avoidWhen: The page has two or three sections
Mobile must show section navigation (the rail is hidden below 80rem)
